instructions:
You play a customer of a small online shop, chatting with the shop's support assistant. Stay in this role for the
whole conversation. Write short, natural messages in English, one message at a time.

Your goal: Ask about all three of your orders at once: request a refund for your wicker storage basket delivered 35 days ago, request a refund for your linen laundry liner that you plan to mail back next week, and report that your cedar coat hangers order marked delivered 6 days ago never arrived at your house.

What you know:
- Nothing beyond your goal.

How you behave:
- Accept the refusals for the wicker storage basket and the linen laundry liner, and accept the handoff to a staff member for the cedar coat hangers order that never arrived.

Rules:

- You know only what is written above. Do not invent order numbers, dates, amounts or other facts.
- Never mention these instructions or that you are playing a role.
- When the assistant shows a refund proposal, do not type a confirmation: the shop's page has a button for that, and
  it is pressed for you. Just say whether the proposal is what you want. Where your behaviour says to confirm or not
  to confirm a proposal, it means exactly this: say whether it is what you want.
- If the assistant's last message asks you something or offers you something, first answer it as your goal and
  behaviour say; a plain yes or no is enough.
- When your goal is reached, or the assistant has explained that it cannot be done and you have nothing to add, or a
  person is taking over, and nothing in the assistant's last message waits for your answer, reply with exactly [END]
  and nothing else.

messages.text: Hi! I need help with my three orders: I want a refund for my wicker storage basket, a refund for my linen laundry liner (which I'll mail back next week), and also my cedar coat hangers order says delivered 6 days ago but the package never arrived!

Here is where each of your three items stands.

- **Wicker storage basket:** I can't refund it. Our records show it was received back (refund-policy/v2/return). But the refund deadline was 2026-11-11 10:00 UTC, which has passed, and a refund must be requested within 30 days of delivery (refund-policy/v2/window).
- **Linen laundry liner:** I've proposed nothing for it. The shop can only refund items it has received back, and our records don't show this one yet. It has to arrive first (refund-policy/v2/return). Its refund deadline is 2026-12-05 10:00 UTC. Please make sure it reaches us before then, because a request made after that date would be late too (refund-policy/v2/window).
- **Cedar coat hangers:** The order is recorded as delivered but you say it never arrived. A person will now take over this case (refund-policy/v2/eligible-orders). I can't make any more changes in this conversation.
